'''Barbara Seliger Larsen''' is a mass spectrometrist, with a career in instrumentations and applications of mass spectrometry in industry, and served on the board of the [[American Society for Mass Spectrometry]] for several terms.<ref name=":2">{{Cite journal |last1=Brenner |first1=Anne |last2=Simpson |first2=Hayes |date=2021-09-01 |title=Faces of Mass Spectrometry/Barbara Larsen |journal=Journal of the American Society for Mass Spectrometry |language=en |volume=32 |issue=9 |pages=2281–2283 |doi=10.1021/jasms.1c00229 |pmid=34375110 |s2cid=236978779 |issn=1044-0305|doi-access=free }}</ref>

== Early life and education ==
Larsen earned a BS in chemistry from [[Santa Clara University]] in 1978, and a PhD in chemistry under the direction of Douglas P. Ridge from [[University of Delaware]] in 1983.<ref name=":1">{{Cite book |title=Mass spectrometry of biological materials |date=1998 |publisher=Marcel Dekker |others=Barbara Seliger Larsen, Charles N. McEwen |isbn=0-585-11050-6 |edition=2nd ed., rev. and expanded |location=New York |oclc=44959064}}</ref> She completed her post-doctoral research with [[Catherine Clarke Fenselau|Catherine Fenselau]] at [[Johns Hopkins University]].<ref name=":2" />

== Career ==

Larsen worked for more than 35 years at [[DuPont]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Barbara Larsen Receives EAS Award for Outstanding Achievements in Mass Spectrometry |url=https://www.spectroscopyonline.com/view/barbara-larsen-receives-eas-award-for-outstanding-achievements-in-mass-spectrometry |access-date=2022-06-08 |website=Spectroscopy Online |date=30 September 2020 |language=en}}</ref> In her research in [[mass spectrometry]], she worked with a number of ionization sources, from [[electrospray ionization]],<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Larsen |first1=Barbara S. |last2=McEwen |first2=Charles N. |date=1991-05-01 |title=An electrospray ion source for magnetic sector mass spectrometers |url=https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1016/1044-0305%2891%2980045-9 |journal=Journal of the American Society for Mass Spectrometry |language=en |volume=2 |issue=3 |pages=205–211 |doi=10.1016/1044-0305(91)80045-9 |pmid=24242274 |bibcode=1991JASMS...2..205L |s2cid=40950182 |issn=1044-0305|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last1=McEwen |first1=Charles N. |last2=Simonsick |first2=William J. |last3=Larsen |first3=Barbara S. |last4=Ute |first4=Kaichi |last5=Hatada |first5=Koichi |date=1995-10-01 |title=The fundamentals of applying electrospray ionization mass spectrometry to low mass poly(methyl methacrylate) polymers |url=https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1016/1044-0305%2895%2900476-T |journal=Journal of the American Society for Mass Spectrometry |language=en |volume=6 |issue=10 |pages=906–911 |doi=10.1016/1044-0305(95)00476-T |pmid=24214034 |bibcode=1995JASMS...6..906M |s2cid=21026081 |issn=1044-0305|url-access=subscription }}</ref> [[matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionization]],<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=McEwen |first1=Charles N. |last2=Jackson |first2=Christian |last3=Larsen |first3=Barbara S. |date=1997 |title=Instrumental effects in the analysis of polymers of wide polydispersity by MALDI mass spectrometry |url=https://linkinghub.elsevier.com/retrieve/pii/S0168117696045016 |journal=International Journal of Mass Spectrometry and Ion Processes |language=en |volume=160 |issue=1–3 |pages=387–394 |doi=10.1016/S0168-1176(96)04501-6|bibcode=1997IJMSI.160..387M |url-access=subscription }}</ref> solid probe introduction with corona discharge ionization,<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=McEwen |first1=Charles N. |last2=McKay |first2=Richard G. |last3=Larsen |first3=Barbara S. |date=2005-12-01 |title=Analysis of Solids, Liquids, and Biological Tissues Using Solids Probe Introduction at Atmospheric Pressure on Commercial LC/MS Instruments |url=https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1021/ac051470k |journal=Analytical Chemistry |language=en |volume=77 |issue=23 |pages=7826–7831 |doi=10.1021/ac051470k |pmid=16316194 |issn=0003-2700|url-access=subscription }}</ref> to laserspray ionization.<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=McEwen |first1=Charles N. |last2=Larsen |first2=Barbara S. |last3=Trimpin |first3=Sarah |date=2010-06-15 |title=Laserspray Ionization on a Commercial Atmospheric Pressure-MALDI Mass Spectrometer Ion Source: Selecting Singly or Multiply Charged Ions |url=https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1021/ac1006624 |journal=Analytical Chemistry |language=en |volume=82 |issue=12 |pages=4998–5001 |doi=10.1021/ac1006624 |pmid=20469839 |issn=0003-2700|url-access=subscription }}</ref> Her fluorinated polymer extraction method,<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Larsen |first1=Barbara S. |last2=Kaiser |first2=Mary A. |last3=Botelho |first3=Miguel |last4=Wooler |first4=Gilbert R. |last5=Buxton |first5=L. William |date=2005 |title=Comparison of pressurized solvent and reflux extraction methods for the determination of perfluorooctanoic acid in polytetrafluoroethylene polymers using LC-MS-MS |url=http://xlink.rsc.org/?DOI=b412609b |journal=The Analyst |language=en |volume=130 |issue=1 |pages=59–62 |doi=10.1039/b412609b |pmid=15614354 |bibcode=2005Ana...130...59L |issn=0003-2654|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Larsen |first1=Barbara S. |last2=Kaiser |first2=Mary A. |last3=Botelho |first3=Miguel A. |last4=Bachmura |first4=Stanley F. |last5=Buxton |first5=L. William |date=2006 |title=Efficient "total" extraction of perfluorooctanoate from polytetrafluoroethylene fluoropolymer |url=http://xlink.rsc.org/?DOI=B606801D |journal=The Analyst |language=en |volume=131 |issue=10 |pages=1105–1108 |doi=10.1039/B606801D |pmid=17003857 |bibcode=2006Ana...131.1105L |issn=0003-2654|url-access=subscription }}</ref> the Larsen method, is required by the [[United States Environmental Protection Agency|Environmental Protection Agency]] for consumer safety.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2017 |title=News and Views |url=https://www.asms.org/docs/default-source/jasms/12-2017_news-views7018190ea09c6d75a448ff000066efb8.pdf?sfvrsn=358474c3_0 |access-date=2022-06-08 |website=American Society for Mass Spectrometry}}</ref> She is a consultant at Larsen Scientific Consulting.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Spectroscopy Editorial Advisory Board |url=https://www.spectroscopyonline.com/view/spectroscopy-editorial-advisory-board |access-date=2022-06-08 |website=Spectroscopy Online |date=January 2019 |language=en}}</ref>

She serves on the editorial advisory board of [[Spectroscopy (magazine)|''Spectroscopy'']].<ref name=":0" /> She was an editor for the ''[[Journal of the American Society for Mass Spectrometry]]''.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Journal of The American Society for Mass Spectrometry |url=https://www.springer.com/journal/13361/editors |access-date=2022-06-08 |website=Springer |date=December 2019 |language=en}}</ref> She served on a number of board positions for the American Society for Mass Spectrometry: treasurer (1992-1994), vice president for programs (2004-2006), president (2006-2008), and past president (2008-2010).<ref>{{Cite web |title=Past Presidents |url=https://www.asms.org/about/past-presidents |access-date=2022-06-08 |website=www.asms.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=ASMS Board of Directors History |url=https://www.asms.org/docs/default-source/board/board-history-2020.pdf?sfvrsn=fd9571c3_0 |access-date=2022-06-07 |website=American Society for Mass Spectrometry}}</ref> She was elected as an American Chemical Society Fellow in 2017.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2017-06-22 |title=Seven Division Members Elected as American Chemical Society Fellows |url=https://acsanalytical.org/2017/06/22/seven-division-members-elected-as-american-chemical-society-fellows/ |access-date=2022-06-08 |website=ACS Division of Analytical Chemistry |language=en-US}}</ref>

* 2010 [[American Chemical Society]] The Delaware Section Award<ref>{{Cite web |title=Awards {{!}} ACS {{!}} Delaware Section |url=https://delawareacs.org/awards/ |access-date=2022-06-08 |website=delawareacs.org}}</ref>
* 2015 Dupont Pederson Medal<ref>{{Cite web |title=Barbara S. Larsen Awarded DuPont Pederson Medal |url=https://www.asms.org/asms-news/2015/08/28/barbara-s.-larsen-awarded-dupont-pederson-medal |access-date=2022-06-08 |website=www.asms.org}}</ref>
* 2016 the Analytical Scientist The Power List 2016 Top 50 most influential women<ref>{{Cite web |title=The Power List 2016 |url=https://theanalyticalscientist.com/power-list/the-power-list-2016 |access-date=2022-06-08 |website=The Analytical Scientist |language=en}}</ref>
* 2020 Eastern Analytical Symposium (EAS) Award for Outstanding Achievements in Mass Spectrometry<ref>{{Cite web |title=59th Eastern Analytical Symposium November 16–19, 2020 |url=https://www.spectroscopyonline.com/view/the-59th-eastern-analytical-symposium |access-date=2022-06-08 |website=Spectroscopy Online |date=7 September 2020 |language=en}}</ref>
